description: Open the anvil at (x,y,z) and combine/repair two items (or rename a single item). Identify each input either by inventory slot number (itemOneSlot/itemTwoSlot) or by item name/id (itemOne/itemTwo); slot wins if both are given. Provide only the first item plus `name` to rename. Costs experience levels; result is taken back into inventory.

itemOne.description: First (base) item by name/id (if itemOneSlot not given)

itemOneSlot.description: Inventory slot of the first (base) item

itemTwo.description: Second item by name/id; omit for a rename-only operation

itemTwoSlot.description: Inventory slot of the second (sacrifice/material) item

name.description: New name to apply to the result (optional)

name: anvil_combine
